about.heroDesc: VexGo focuses on core operations: trip search, seat selection, online payment, ticket lookup, valid cancellation, freight shipping, and real-time customer care.
about.coreValuesDesc: Every flow is streamlined so passengers can go from searching trips to receiving e-tickets swiftly with clear status and easy lookup.
about.val1Desc: Fares, schedules, seat maps, and pickup/drop-off points are always publicly and accurately provided by operators.
about.val2Desc: Automated seat holding with real-time locking mechanisms prevents double-booking across all channels.
about.val3Desc: Automated VietQR bank transfer verified in seconds, plus domestic and international card payments.
about.val4Desc: Customer care specialists and direct operator chat support resolve any journey concerns promptly.
about.missionDesc: Build a transparent ticketing system that helps passengers find trips, hold seats, pay, and receive tickets in a seamless workflow.
about.visionDesc: Become the premier trusted platform for intercity bus ticketing and freight forwarding across all routes.
about.coreValDesc: Transparent pricing. Accurate seat holding. Fast payment and real-time alerts.
about.whyDesc: Tailored for intercity passenger transport: timed seat reservations, e-wallets, policy-compliant cancellation, and 24/7 care.
about.benefit1Desc: Book, pay, receive e-tickets, look up, or cancel easily using only order code and phone number without an account.
about.benefit2Desc: Automatic departure reminders, vehicle updates, delay notices, or schedule changes sent directly to passengers.
about.ctaDesc: Create a free account to track trips, earn VexPoints, access member promotions, and manage invoices easily.
